wish: someone should make an app that shows what the camera sees the way a dog sees it
spec:
Shows the camera or a chosen photo twice: normal and as a dog sees it (two-colour blue-yellow vision, reduced detail).
Tap Use camera for live view, Choose photo for a picture, or Sample for a built-in scene; Dog only hides the normal view.
It does not model dog night vision, motion sensitivity or field of view, and sends nothing anywhere.
notes: Camera and photo need browser permission/file; the sample scene is shown by default.
